description: Figure 4 first introduces the two-stage input-to-recurrent-to-output analysis, then uses the selected RNN condition to visualize how input-driven recurrent PCA trajectories map to output trajectories, defines the recurrent excursion and duration features extracted from those trajectories, and quantifies the separately estimated transformations and their composition.

selected_parameters.representative_selection_rule: Canonical cross-figure representative selected for recurrent-trajectory closure and human motor-stage directional matching.

grid_schematic.description: Normalized temporal-by-spatial grids transformed by the across-repetition mean input-to-recurrent and composed input-to-output mappings.

D_recurrent_metric_definitions.trajectory_selection_rule: Three largest displayed-trial onset-referenced excursions per sweep; always retain the central representative condition.
D_recurrent_metric_definitions.excursion_definition: max_t ||z(t) - z(t0)||_2 in the shared recurrent PC1-PC2 plane
D_recurrent_metric_definitions.excursion_formula: Delta z_t = z_t - z_t0; Exc = max_t ||Delta z_t||_2
D_recurrent_metric_definitions.duration_definition: 2pi divided by the robust 10%-90% scale-invariant continuity-constrained shared-template progress velocity
duration_formula_chain: z_tilde(t) = [z(t) - mean_t z(t)] / RMS_t ||z(t) - mean_t z(t)||
q_tilde(phi) = [q(phi) - mean_phi q(phi)] / RMS_phi ||q(phi) - mean_phi q(phi)||
phi_1:N = monotonic open-end minimum-cost path matching z_tilde(t) to q_tilde(phi)
D_recurrent_metric_definitions.display_layout: Equal-sized panels showing three trajectories selected from the five space-sweep and five time-sweep candidates in the top-left and bottom-left subpanels of Figure 4B; no progress-versus-time inset.

display_colormaps.shared_template_phase: solid black line with numeric 0, pi, and 2pi labels

matrix_pattern_reconstruction.definition: 1 - ||B_real - B_composed||_F^2 / ||B_real - mean(B_real)||_F^2, computed separately for each RNN repetition.
matrix_pattern_reconstruction.interpretation: Fraction of the across-entry behavior-matrix pattern reconstructed by the composed linear mappings; this is descriptive and does not test generalization across conditions.
matrix_pattern_reconstruction.baseline: Within-repetition constant matrix equal to the mean of the four real behavior coefficients.

analysis_chain: Panel A introduces the two-stage input-to-recurrent-to-output analysis with transformed grids and symbolic, color-coded matrices without numerical cell annotations. Panel B pairs recurrent PCA trajectories with their output trajectories for space and time input sweeps. Panel C shows across-repetition cumulative recurrent PCA explained variance, emphasizing the first two PCs used for the trajectory analysis. Panel D visualizes the exact recurrent excursion and shared-template duration calculations used to obtain the recurrent scale variables. Panels E-G show across-repetition coefficient distributions for input-to-recurrent, recurrent-to-output, and composed mappings. Panel H compares the composed and real RNN behavior matrices and reports a descriptive, same-condition across-entry matrix-pattern reconstruction R2 rather than an independent generalization test.
